HRA Analysis: OVERVIEW: HOME AND DRY (3) got back into the winner’s circle last start at Cranbourne. He flashed home impressively from midfield up the straight to win well. This race is harder, but he now has the winning confidence. KIMCHI (4) has a good turn of foot, including good gate speed, which he has the option to use here. THE IRISHMAN (2) has had some really tough or unlucky runs recently. He often gets caught wide and needs to cover extra ground racing wide. Last start was his first run in some time where he had a good trip, but he looked to underperform a bit there. From barrier two, he should have some luck. THEROUX (6) is a nice horse who is always competitive. He should be peak fit now as it’s his fourth start back this prep. Tricky barrier. Also respecting NORMANDY NUGGET (1) from the barrier. SELECTIONS:HOME AND DRY (3), KIMCHI (4), THE IRISHMAN (2), THEROUX (6)

OVERVIEW: NIGHT FLIGHT (8) returned with a fourth last start at Melton. He was held up late but hit the line well, and it was a harder race than this one. He will improve with fitness. He always runs well at this track, but he will need some luck from the barrier. JOE LOU (4) is in flying form. He’s won four of his last seven and finished second in the other two. PURPLE MOON (2) has had three starts in the state for a second and two fifths. Last start, she was fifth in the Vicbred Super Series 3yo Silver Trot, which was a tougher race than this. She led on that occasion. She is likely to find the front again here. JILLIBY RADIANCE (5) tired last start in the Group 1 Vicbred Super Series Final. However, it was a terrific result to qualify for the race. In her heat, she contested for the lead and galloped out of the field, caught up and hit the line impressively for fourth. A big winning chance here if she trots throughout and brings her best. Also respecting SHAQ THE ANVIL (1) from the barrier. SELECTIONS:NIGHT FLIGHT (8), JOE LOU (4), PURPLE MOON (2), JILLIBY RADIANCE (1).

OVERVIEW: A SPECIAL OCCASION (8) is a Captaintreacherous-sired three-year-old from New Zealand having his first Australian start for trainer-driver Michael Stanley. He trialled at Melton earlier this month, where he ran home in a fast 26.6 final quarter for the middle trip. He has strong New Zealand form, including a third in the Group 1 Northern Derby, where he stormed home from four fence. He can get off the fence being the only horse on the back row here and will be hard to beat. COOL STORY (3) has been racing well, but he does lack early gate speed, so he often needs to make his own luck. He’s a nice horse, and I’m respecting the Ross Graham-James Herbertson combo here. TEST OF FIRE (2) has brilliant gate speed and won by 25.8 metres at this track two starts ago after leading. However, he is first-up here, so fitness will be a query. MY MARIONETTE (1) has the best sectional times on exposed Australian form in this event. She should get a good trip from barrier one. SELECTIONS: A SPECIAL OCCASION (8), COOL STORY (3), TEST OF FIRE (2), MY MARIONETTE (1)

OVERVIEW: CHILLHUNNYBUNNY (4) was first-up in five months last start when second at Ballarat. She ran home nicely behind No Telling Heather. She will improve on that run with fitness. MAORI TATTOO (6) flashed home nicely into third last start at Maryborough. He has been racing well recently, he just needs some luck from the barrier and to get his manners right. BROOKLYNGOTCOURAGE (2) can get it wrong with her manners, but when she does everything right and gets some luck, she can perform well. Barrier two suits. IM MISS ROYALTY (8) has the best sectional times in this event but is first-up here since July. Also respecting SNICKERS EXPRESS (7) here. He’s good enough to be a winning chance here, but his barrier makes it tricky. BACK: CHILLHUNNYBUNNY (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:CHILLHUNNYBUNNY (4), MAORI TATTOO (6), BROOKLYNGOTCOURAGE (2), IM MISS ROYALTY (8)

OVERVIEW: ULTIMATE GRANGE (7) is having his second career start here. On debut, he went back to last and got held up but did everything right and ran home well. He will improve from the run with experience but has an awkward barrier again here. CALIFORNIA COOL (3) is having his third career start here. He ran a solid third last start behind Le Gaston and Storm Vendetta. He performed well, and I can imagine he will be a maiden for long. RIDE HIGH CAPTIN (2) led last start and was beaten late by the smart King Baldwin. He should be able to map well here from barrier two. ZAV DAN (5) has been racing OK but has a tricky barrier to contend with here. SELECTIONS:ULTIMATE GRANGE (7), CALIFORNIA COOL (3), RIDE HIGH CAPTIN (2), ZAV DAN (5)

OVERVIEW: EL TORNADO (3) is a nice trotter who found his best form last start. He did some work early and then ran home well late to win impressively. He has the winning confidence now. CONSTANT (6) was a well-deserved winner last start at Kilmore. She’s been racing so well and has a great turn of foot. Barrier six is awkward here, but she is a good winning chance again if she has some luck. WHY NOT (2) will get a good trip now with the scratching from barrier one. He’s only had the four career starts but looks to be a talented type. WHISKEY DAWN (7) is an interesting trotter. She clearly has ability and has run some nice races in her short career. She also hasn’t had the best luck and can get it wrong with her manners. It will be tough from barrier seven here, but a win also wouldn’t surprise. BACK: EL TORNADO (3) – 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:EL TORNADO (3), CONSTANT (6), WHY NOT (2), WHISKEY DAWN (7)

OVERVIEW: MISS ADDI (7) is a smart mare who has only missed a place once in her career. She flashed home into second two starts ago at Melton and followed that up with a win last start at Cranbourne after finding the front. She may not have luck here from the barrier, but her class will likely still shine through. MY ATLANTIS (2) is third-up here after over a year on the sidelines, so expecting an improved performance here with fitness. Last start, she wasn’t pushed at Geelong but seemed to run home OK. From the barrier, she should perform well. STORM VENDETTA (4) has run two good seconds in his last two starts. He raced in the breeze and battled on well for second last start. He can race well again here. STEEL MIKI (5) returns here first-up since March. He was a good winner in the breeze last start before his break at Swan Hill. He is lightly raced and appears like a horse who will improve with age, so I am expecting an even better preparation from him this time in. BACK: MISS ADDI (7) – 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS: MISS ADDI (7), MY ATLANTIS (2), STORM VENDETTA (4), STEEL MIKI (5)

OVERVIEW: THEMIDNIGHTEXPRESS (2) is a smart horse who qualified for the Group 1 APG Vicbred Super Series Final last start, but a racing incident from the first attempt saw him scratched. However, he is racing really well, has the gate speed to find the front and has the best sectional times in this event. He will be hard to beat. MATRIARCH DAISY (4) is lightly raced, but at her best she is a nice horse. If she relies on her speed here and is saved for one run, she could be flashing home nicely late. MAJOR ROY (5) is third-up here and will be close to peak race fitness. He was held up late last start but looked to be hitting the line really well. IM THE REASON (3) is first-up here after two Maryborough trial victories. He has ability at his best. BACK: THEMIDNIGHTEXPRESS (2) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:THEMIDNIGHTEXPRESS (2), MATRIARCH DAISY (4), MAJOR ROY (5), IM THE REASON (3) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:BOSS MAJOR (1) hasn’t been at his best form for some time but he is perfectly drawn in a suitable race and has the services of leading reinsman James Herbertson so he gets his chance to improve. JOEYS HANGOVER (6) is resuming since a third at Shepparton in June. He is a fast beginner and he is usually competitive against this class so he is worth an investment. ALLTHEWAYTOROYALTY (4) was runner up at Ballarat on August 05 and has joined local trainer Michael Gadsden since his latest unplaced performance. He is worth thought under these conditions. MY LUCKY ROCK (2) is resuming since a fifth at Melton in July 2025. She lacks recent racing but she was racing in reasonable form at the end of her last preparation so she has claims if she is somewhere near her peak. She raced without cover when a reasonable fourth at a Maryborough trial effort last week. SELECTIONS: BOSS MAJOR (1), JOEYS HANGOVER (6), ALLTHEWAYROYALTY (4), MY LUCKY ROCK (2)

OVERVIEW:OVER THE LINE (6) led out then took cover and was held up for momentum on the home turn before using the sprint lane when she finished second behind Chainsmoke at Swan Hill last week. She should be getting close to her peak form after having two starts back from a break and is worth following. FLEUR BELLA (1) has performed nicely in three starts since coming from New South Wales and was able to lead throughout at Mildura last outing. She is drawn to lead again and should take catching. TORQUE INTHEUSA (7) has had a few chances since returning from South Australia but he is dropping back into a more suitable class now and he met a smart one in Farroh Joe at Stawell last outing so he warrants consideration. SKIPPYS DELIGHT (5) was runner up in a slick mile of 1.54.8 at Geelong two starts ago and is not without a chance under these conditions. SELECTIONS: OVER THE LINE (6), FLEUR BELLA (1), TORQUE INTHEUSA (7), SKIPPYS DELIGHT (5)

OVERVIEW: ELLI JOH (8) recorded a personal best mile rate of 1.57.3 when she scored at Hamilton then followed with a handy second behind Justlikedave in fast time at Cranbourne. She is awkwardly drawn but will find this race to be no harder. ESPERANZA (7) led out then took cover and used the sprint lane when a close second behind Major Lincoln at Stawell last outing. She scored at Kilmore three starts ago and she should give another bold showing under these conditions. THE LADYBIRD (4) finished off well for third at Wagga two starts ago then missed out at Kilmore last outing. She can sprint to the line quickly with the right trail forward and is worth thought. TASTE IT (5) and SKADI (6) have both won against similar grade recently and are not without a chance. SELECTIONS: ELLI JOH (8), ESPERANZA (7), THE LADYBIRD (4), SKADI (6)

OVERVIEW: ARZALI ROCKSTAR (6) will appreciate a massive drop back in class on her past three performances during the Super Series. She made it through to the Group 1 Final and she defeated a reasonable field at a Ballarat victory in July so she should prove hard to beat against this line up. JUST LIKE NUGGET (5) continues to race consistently and was held up for a run at a vital stage when he finished off well for third behind Farroh Joe at Stawell last week. He should run his usual honest race. OPERTSER (1) continues to improve with the benefit of racing and went to the line jogging with no clear run when an unlucky fourth at Cranbourne last week. He is drawn to trail the likely leader SMOKING SHANNON (2) and should be finishing fast along the passing lane. SMOKING SHANNON (2) is a fast beginner and performs best when she is able to lead. She does prefer competing over the sprint distance but she is worth thought from her good draw. BACK: ARZALI ROCKSTAR (6) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: ARZALI ROCKSTAR (6), JUST LIKE NUGGET (5), OPERTSER (1), SMOKING SHANNON (2)

OVERVIEW:AMADA VILLMA (2) is a fast beginner and is a good chance of attempting an all of the way victory from her good draw over the sprint distance. She was shuffled to three back on the markers mid-race and moved up without cover at the 900m mark when a creditable third at Swan Hill last outing. MISS ADELIA (1) raced without cover throughout and did well for second behind Queens Boulevard at Stawell on debut. She should have improved by the experience and she is ideally drawn so she is capable of going one better. EVIE KATE (4) finished off nicely in a last quarter of 28.1 seconds when a close second at a Maryborough trial effort last week and appears to have a promising future. CAPTAIN MILO (7) trailed the leader and was held up badly for a run when an unlucky fifth behind Piastri at Shepparton last week. He missed out narrowly at Kilmore prior and he has claims despite being drawn on the outside of the front line. ARZALI SHACARRI (8) was beaten by a long way on debut but the time was fast and this race appears to be a little easier. The first starter PHILS BOY (3) has shown ability in several trial efforts andmust be kept safe. SELECTIONS: AMADA VILLMA (2), MISS ADELIA (1), EVIE KATE (4), CAPTAIN MILO (7)

OVERVIEW:RAPTA (6) finished fifth in a heat of the Super Series then followed with a fifth in the Final (Group 1) so he will appreciate a massive drop back in class for this assignment. He wasn’t beaten by far behind Howdy Mate in the Super Series Final so he was far from disgraced and should make his presence felt here. EL UNO (2) is resuming since July but he recorded handy time at an easy trial victory at Maryborough last week and is drawn to go well. ALDEBARAN MIGUEL (8) settled three back on the markers, moved up without cover at the 800m and hit the front approaching the home turn before being run down late when second behind Alectrona at Cranbourne last outing. He is awkwardly drawn but should be working home well. FRANKS ALOT (5) finished off nicely for fourth behind the smart mare Little Miss Morgan at a Shepparton trial performance and is not to be underestimated. SKYE DIVA (4) has performed fairly well at the trials and must be kept safe. BACK: RAPTA (6) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: RAPTA (6), EL UNO (2), ALDEBARAN MIGUEL (8), FRANKS ALOT (5)

OVERVIEW: CHAMPAGNE CHARLEY (10) was resuming since February when he finished off solidly for a close second at Kilmore. He faces a big handicap but he should be fitter and he is a proven winner from the standing start so he warrants respect. KAMARAN (9) can make mistakes occasionally but he is a smart horse when he can put it altogether. He pushed around the field mid-race to park without cover from the 900m when a game second behind Majestic Tooth in a mile rate of 1.57.7 at his latest appearance. BOUTIKA (7) is stepping up in class but is racing in career best form and broke the track record when she won at Ararat two starts ago so she cannot be underestimated. WATCH AND ACT (8) is a quick beginner and boasts a handy standing start record so he rates as a value hope. CONNIES PRESIDENT (5) and POPPY POPSTAR (6) are both capable of showing up without surprising. SELECTIONS: CHAMPAGNE CHARLEY (10), KAMARAN (9), BOUTIKA (7), WATCH AND ACT (8)

OVERVIEW: TOPSIE BEWARE (4) won convincingly at Ararat when on debut back in March then was spelled. She has had numerous trials leading up to her second attempt and she scored at the Bacchus Marsh trials last week so she must be respected. OWEN THE SAINTS (9) recorded a handy mile rate of 1.56.7 when he scored at Kilmore on September 03 and was held up for a run at a vital stage at his latest unlucky third. He follows out behind a reasonable beginner and will be hard to hold out in the run to the finish. SPORTING RAGE (8) is likely to be shuffled back on the markers from the inside of the second line but he is racing well enough to figure in the finish. He won from behind the leader at Charlton two starts ago and should be finding the line strongly again. FIVE CENT (2) is a grinding type that performs best when he is close to the pace. He will prove hard to beat if he can work forward to find the lead shortly after the start. BACK: TOPSIE BEWARE (4) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: TOPSIE BEWARE (4), OWEN THE SAINTS (9), SPORTING RAGE (8), FIVE CENT (2)

OVERVIEW: OUR SWEET JEANNIE (3) is a smart filly, which has been racing in the Super Series with her latest performance being a sixth behind Bettor Beach in the Final. She is versatile and should make her presence felt from the good draw. LEONARD (1) led throughout in a handy mile rate of 1.55.1 at Swan Hill last week and is perfectly drawn again. This is a field of more depth but he should be competitive again. TELEMACHUS (11) is poorly drawn but he appears to be very well graded in this event. He progressed forward to find the lead when a close up fourth behind Blake Bolac at Metropolitan level last outing. KATUNGA EXPRESS (8) has the perfect trailing draw behind LEONARD (1) and possesses a handy finishing burst so he rates as a value hope. TOPSIES BLING (9) sprinted sharply to win in slick time at Ballarat last outing and has won a trial since. She is a speedy mare and is not without a chance. BACK: OUR SWEET JEANNIE (3) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: OUR SWEET JEANNIE (3), LEONARD (1), TELEMACHUS (11), KATUNGA EXPRESS (8)

OVERVIEW:CHINSKI (4) is having his first start at Echuca but based on his racing pattern, should love the circuit. He finds a draw to use his gate speed and find the top over the short distance, which is a huge advantage on the tighter track with the shorter straight. He was a winner two starts back, where he unsuccessfully challenged for the lead before coming again to win. His mobile record is strong and, if the map works out, he’ll take some catching. JILLIBY TOPGUN (9) has plenty of upside based on what he’s been able to produce this season, winning five from 16, and the concession claim of Tasmyn Potter brings him well in on the ratings scale. His last performance at this track saw him do work and be beaten a distance, so whilst he’s better suited on the bigger tracks, he’s in the mix. MAJESTIC MONARCH (10) is also well graded with the claim, but he is coming off a very disappointing run at Shepparton last week, where he was well supported, led and dropped out. His form prior was good, so if you can overlook last time, he’s a genuine chance. WHATS THE TEA (3) is having his first try here and gets the services of ace reinsman James Herbertson. He needs to be better than last start, but this is easier. KALARNEY PRINCE (2) also has minor claims, as his tactical speed should see him map in a favourable position. BACK: CHINSKI (4) – 1.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:CHINSKI (4), JILLIBY TOPGUN (9), MAJESTIC MONARCH (10), WHATS THE TEA (3)

OVERVIEW:ARRAPS (5) is a speedy beginner and looks well served from the draw to press forward aggressively and look for the top end against this opposition. His track and distance profile is also strong for a race of this calibre, and his past two runs leading into this have been very good. The work he had to do last time and the sectionals he was able to produce suggest he can be too strong for these. WHERES WOOD WOOD (11) caught many by surprise last week when he was able to lead and dash away, running good time at Shepparton. In fairness, he has been consistent overall this season, and although his set-up is completely different this time, his record at this track commands respect. TOMMYS LOOKOUT (6) can be a little hard to catch, but his performance three starts back to win at Shepparton was good enough to be competitive here. It’s hard to know how he maps and his last two runs have been poor, but he’s worth keeping safe. STELLAR QUEEN (1) and FOUR STARZZZ RUBY (3) are the other speed influences off the front row, and the right map gives them claims, particularly at the minor end. SELECTIONS:ARRAPS (5), WHERES WOOD WOOD (11), TOMMYS LOOKOUT (6), STELLAR QUEEN (1)

OVERVIEW:SOHO PLAYGIRL (4) was terrific last week in winning at her first run for the new stable, where she let down with a powerful finishing burst. Her career profile suggests her best performances come when she can draw to race handy, and the map may be in her favour here. She has a good strike rate at the track and, if she can back up what she did last week, will be hard to hold out. STARZINHEREYES (3) is a quick beginner suited to this track and distance. Her past two runs back in more suitable grade have been very good, and those efforts have come with Luke Dunne in the sulky, who sticks with her here. ELIZAJANE (6) is flying, winning her past couple when able to lead and running good time in both. BULLETPROOF KID (5) has been a model of consistency this campaign and got a deserved win when able to lead at Cranbourne two starts back. This map is a little sticky, but he’s certainly in the mix. SELECTIONS:SOHO PLAYGIRL (4), STARZINHEREYES (3), ELIZAJANE (6), BULLETPROOF KID (5)

OVERVIEW: ALTO CORRAGIO (3) has been runner-up in both career starts, both over 2190m at Shepparton. On debut he showed gate speed, led and was beaten only a half-head. Last week he came from the second row and was narrowly beaten again. He has a strong trainer/driver combination and, with a positive map over a similar middle distance against an easier field, it heavily favours him breaking through. MAJOR FRIEND (1) is the obvious danger and gets the map advantage. She’s placed six times from nine starts, including four of her past five, and has already shown the ability to trail the top pick and get her chance. She came through the same race last week but didn’t have much luck. Those two clearly stand out. SLOWBURN (7) is a 2yo from the Riverina whose two performances to date boast a solid SP profile, and those runs have been okay. Likely to be three pegs means minor consideration is more realistic. JUST MY LUCK (4) needs to lift on what he’s displayed, but there have been glimpses of ability to suggest he can improve against a moderate line-up. BACK: ALTO CORRAGIO (3) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:ALTO CORRAGIO (3), MAJOR FRIEND (1), SLOWBURN (7), JUST MY LUCK (4)

OVERVIEW:FERRIGNO (2) hasn’t won since October last year, but there’s a strong case to be made for him breaking that run of outs. He’s been racing up in grade for quite a while and, furthermore, hasn’t had the best set-up to put his best foot forward, which is when he’s able to lead. He’s having his first look at Echuca, but his tactical speed can see him get back to his best. TARA VICTORY (8) has been performing well for her in-form stable, and when she found a suitable grade two starts back, she won easily. She should map quite well trailing out the top pick, so although she’s going to have to earn it from off the speed, she’s a strong chance. HELLOVATIME (6) is another in great form and nearly went all the way last week. His record this campaign is excellent, and he has gone close in two tries at this track; he will just need luck from the draw. DRESSED IN GOLD (4) is yet to win this preparation but is showing signs that a win isn’t far away. This is quality opposition, though, while MICHEN ROY (5) had to work hard last week and dropped out, but he’s honest and won’t be far away. BACK: FERRIGNO (2) – 1.5 units (win) SELECTIONS: FERRIGNO (2), TARA VICTORY (8), HELLOVATIME (6), DRESSED IN GOLD (4)

OVERVIEW: A tricky map to work out here, but if REGAL ROCK (5) can get across, he will be hard to run down. His two runs this campaign have been solid in harder company, where he found the top and battled on well. This is significantly easier and, if he gets to the peg line, he’s capable of running faster times than the opposition. DOT BALL (7) has the challenge of overcoming the back row, but if there’s a strong battle for the lead, he will be the beneficiary. He’s won two of his past four, drops in grade and is a winner at this track. ALPHA CRUCIS (3) could be the one open to sharp improvement on his numerical form, finding a suitable draw and set-up. He’s a winner at this track and, with the right map, he’ll be in the finish. Then at the minor end, SWISS LIGHTNING (1) can map softly, while KRAKEY (4) goes okay at this level but is fresh-up here and the map is sticky. SELECTIONS: REGAL ROCK (5), DOT BALL (7), ALPHA CRUCIS (3), KRAKEY (4)

OVERVIEW:BIG RAIN (1) is a 14-start maiden, but she has placed eight times and this, by far, looks to be her most suitable assignment. She has natural gate speed, which has seen her lead at her past three starts, and here at Echuca she looks well suited with the shorter straight to cling on. She won’t strike a more winnable race. MI BOW (3) is a 35-start maiden and has placed 17 times. She’s getting closer and has a strong SP profile for a race of this calibre, while the Herbertson factor is a plus. SPESHAL (7) is also racing well without winning, and her failures at her past two have been a result of galloping out. If she can get away and map behind the leader, she’s a chance. GREAT HORIZON (2) doesn’t threaten to win, but she is reliable in her gait, so if others get it wrong, she can be the last one standing. BACK: BIG RAIN (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: BIG RAIN (1), MI BOW (3), SPESHAL (7), GREAT HORIZON (2)

OVERVIEW:FINAL BOW (3) has 36 career wins and, crucially, an exceptional Echuca record of 14 starts for five wins. She won consecutive races at Shepparton before the Maryborough failure and bounced back with a second last week, where the leader was off and gone by the time she made her run. She can map more positively from this draw and, if she finds the top, will be hard to run down. MAMMALS REASON (5) is a model of consistency with two wins and three placings from her past five. The concern is how she maps from the draw, but her form is good enough to be a winning hope. HIGHVIEW HAMMER (1) is a quick beginner and normally likes to take cover, so gets the ideal map from barrier 1. His last win in June came when he was able to sit leader’s back. SPORTS WRACK (6) keeps threatening to bounce back to form as he continues to drop in grade. The draw here hurts, but he’s one who is ready to win in this grade when things work out. BACK: FINAL BOW (3)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:FINAL BOW (3), MAMMALS REASON (5), HIGHVIEW HAMMER (1), SPORTS WRACK (6)

TAKE MY WALLET (1) has now joined the Matt Maguire stable. He finds a winnable draw against a winnable field. If he is anywhere near his best then he will be hard to beat tonight. TWO WAY WONDER (2) looks like a big threat with Ryan Hryhorec in the sulky. BARACK ENOBRAC (5) and UPRIGHT (3) are also chances.

EMILY MEGAN (6) nearly lead all of the way first up from a spell last start at Gawler. She should be able to improve off that run but the stand start is a big concern since she hasn’t had one before. MAGICAL MADGE (1), VOUCHER QUEEN (3) and JILLIBY BLISS (5) are also chances.

GIAMATTI (1) is a good chance of holding the lead from the inside draw. If he does lead then he will be hard to run down. He is worth strong each way consideration tonight. A MAJOR STARR (6) was a winner here at Globe Derby two starts back. He is a good chance again tonight if he can repeat that sort of run. MANDS PEARL (9) and SEA HUNTER (5) are also chances.

BRANSON (6) has run some encouraging placings his last two outings against trickier fields. The draw isn’t ideal but he finds a winnable race tonight. He looks ready to win. PARISIAN BANDIT (1) will be a major threat if he gains a start. WHITESTARCHRISTIAN (9) finds a much easier race tonight and he could easily shake this sort of race up if he is anywhere near his best. LOCHINVAR RULER (10) and ACES SHADOW (7) are also chances.

JUST BECCY (2) will get the inside draw if MY GIRL MIA doesn’t gain a start as the emergency. She should be able to hold the lead and run a cheeky race out on top. TUFFASNAILS (5) has had the two starts in SA now. He has been a little disappointing but he could be a big improver tonight. SWEETKINDOFMAGIC (11) and LORD MYRMECIA (6) are also chances.

CHILDERS ROAD (6) was a winner two starts back when he defeated a similar field after leading all of the way. A repeat of that run will put him right in the mix tonight. MEET ME AT THE BEACH (5), PARISIAN BANDIT (4) and UPTOWN MISS (1) are also chances.

LUNADIVA (2) has run second three of her last five starts. She has been edging closer to a win and tonight she gets a big opportunity in this sort of race from the good draw. RIDE THE HIGHWAY (4), ANGRYPANTS ANGIE (6) and CLARENDEN ARCADIA (8) are also chances.

ROAD STAR (1) does his best racing when he can lead from gate one. He should be able to hold the lead tonight and lead all of the way. JACKIE DANIELS (3) didn’t run a bad race first up at Gawler last start. She could improve a lot tonight. AMIRA MARIE (4) and ROCKNROLL SPIRIT (6) are also chances.

THE CLIPPER (7) has been running better races recently. He ran a handy second behind FEEL THE MOMENT two starts back. He knows how to handle the stand start and he looks like a big chance tonight. NOTHING I WANT (4) ran second first up last week at Gawler behind QUARTARARO. She is a major chance tonight. BROOKIES BABE (1) and SAVVY KYVALLEY (6) are also chances.

JILTED (1) has shown some ability at the trials. Her stable and her driver must be respected in a very tricky race to judge. CASH ME UP (2), BORN ELITE (4) and SEAPARADEGIRLIE (3) are all worth consideration in a race where market moves may be the best guide. SEABREEZE LAD (1) is a talented two year old with a lot of upside. He is first up from a spell but he is well drawn and should have matured since his runs earlier in the year. He is a massive chance tonight. CRUNCH RULES (2) looks like a big danger after breaking his maiden last start here at Port Pirie. SAL WESTER (3) and TIGER MUMFF (5) are both chances as well.

FEARFULL DRAGON (3) has won his last two starts in an impressive fashion. He should be able to lead all the way today and be hard to beat again. SPORTSFLIGHT (6) returned to the winners list last start and looks like a danger again today. He races very well here at Port Pirie. GRUMPYPANTS GRACIE (2) and ITZ BLACKJACK (4) are also chances.

ALORA (3) won by 18.3 meters last start at Gawler as she returned to racing in a big way. A repeat of that run will make her awfully hard to beat today. SO SIRIUS (5) finds an easier race compared to his first two starts in South Australia. He is first up from a spell and hasn’t been seen at the trials. It may pay to watch his market moves. REPELLING (6) and MISTER QUIRK (2) are also chances.

NORMANS GIRL (6) ran a handy race first up here at Port Pirie last start when she ran second behind SPORTSFLIGHT. She will find today easier and if she can improve off that run then she will be hard to beat. MACHFREDDY (4) looks like the main danger after a strong all the way win at Gawler last start. BROBENAH GIRL (1) and I NEED AGIRLFRIEND (3) are also chances.

ELLA KATE (9) has won two of her last four starts. The draw isn’t ideal for her today but she does race well here at Port Pirie and she finds a race she can win today. WELL WELL (1), PERFECT GAMBLE (4) and KEILAH (5) are also chances.

NITEONTHETOWN (6) has the tough draw to overcome but I love the way he has been racing recently. He ran a nice race behind PLAY IT COOL last start. He could easily feature today if he gets the right run into the race. BALLADORO (3) is drawn well and was impressive at Gawler last start. INSIDER TRADING (7) and LINCS POOR BOY (2) are also chances. ONE LAST ROLL (1) has good gate speed and finds a race where he may be able to drive through and lead. He was forced to race without cover last time out at Marburg and battled on well there for fourth. SATURDAY DANCE (7) put in a very nice run last time out when securing the leaders back trail behind Pumpkin Pat and was able to run straight by that horse late to score well at Marburg. She should get a similar run and will be hard to hold out again. PUMPKIN PAT (6) didn’t quite go to her best last time out when working to the lead before fading out of it late into fifth behind B Mac C. She looks well suited in this grade of race and should be able to bounce back. LETHAL LOUIE (5) got back in the run last time out at Marburg and was finishing it off strongly into second behind B Mac C. He should get a good run off the speed again in this race and if the race is run to suit he should be running on strongly. SELECTIONS: ONE LAST ROLL (1), SATURDAY DANCE (7), PUMPKIN PAT (6), LETHAL LOUIE (5) SUGGESTED BET: SATURDAY DANCE (7) each way.

DENIS THE PUNTER (2) was able to zip to the lead last time out before rolling even sectionals and dug deep late to score. He is likely to look to adopt similar tactics in this race from a good draw and can prove hard to catch again. ROCKIN SWEET (4) was crossed early last time out before being shuffled back in the field by a tiring runner and was still able to run through the line quite well late. He may look to press forward and appears to find the right type of race. PENNIE PACKER (7) draws awkwardly inside the back row in this race and will need a few things to go her way in the run. She was forced to race without cover last time out over the 2138 at Albion Park and battled on reasonably for seventh. VINCENT TIME (6) sat without cover last time out at Redcliffe and was able to battle away well for fourth behind Merry Jewel. He may be forced to do work again in this race but could find this a touch easier. SELECTIONS: DENIS THE PUNTER (2), ROCKIN SWEET (4), PENNIE PACKER (7), VINCENT TIME (6) SUGGESTED BET: DENIS THE PUNTER (2) to win.

IDEAL TIGER (1) appears to find a race where he should be able to drive through and lead in the early stages. He was excellent two starts ago when running over the top to score in a race which wasn’t run to suit. BRITTS MATE (2) finally broke through for another win two starts ago when getting back and coming over the top late to score a big win. She draws well in this race and should settle close enough to figure in the finish again. ULTIMATE HUNTER (3) scored an impressive win last time out when appearing to over race badly when sitting without cover and simply proving too good for his rivals. He may be left do the work again but may have derived benefit from his first up outing. NEED NOT TO WARRY (6) draws wide in this race and will need the race run to suit to bring him into it. He ran a very good race last time out when running on strongly into third behind Denis The Punter. SELECTIONS: IDEAL TIGER (1), BRITTS MATE (2), ULTIMATE HUNTER (3), NEED NOT TO WARRY (6) SUGGESTED BET: IDEAL TIGER (1) to win.

JUKEBOX JET (6) sat without cover last time out and was very good there finishing a close up second behind Sammys Secret in good time for the grade. He may be forced to do some work again in this race but shouldn’t find this any harder than his latest outing. COPY WRITER (1) has gate speed and a good draw in this race. She hasn’t had a lot of luck in recent outings including last time out when doing work before being left without cover which wouldn’t have suited her. KEAYANG TARA (3) didn’t do herself any favours in recent stand start outings finding herself out the back due to early errors. She should settle close enough in this race and appears very well graded. SKYLAR BREE (5) finished eighth last time out but looked to be particularly unlucky there when held up for clear running at Marburg. She draws wide and will need a few things to go her way in the run but looks capable. SELECTIONS: JUKEBOX JET (6), COPY WRITER (1), KEAYANG TARA (3), SKYLAR BREE (5) SUGGESTED BET: JUKEBOX JET (6) to win.

CHECHINGOUTTHEBILL (8) returns from a spell in this race without a trial which looks a query. He took on a much stronger race last time out and wasn’t beaten too far behind Schooners and a number of other capable horses. With the right run he should go close. THATS OUR BOY (2) showed good gate speed to lead in a recent trial at Marburg before taking a sit on the higher assessed Cosmic Flyer and was able to run second to that horse. He should be able to find a prominent position in this race and should run well from there. VICTREE BUSTA (3) finished fourth last time out in a race where there was a genuine tempo and the winner Holme Boy rated good time for the grade. He should settle close again and has each way claims on his best. WICKED DE LIL (4) took on a much stronger race last time out when well beaten by Notions and Northview Cruncha. She should find this much easier but does draw a touch awkwardly. SELECTIONS: CHECHINGOUTTHEBILL (8), THATS OUR BOY (2), VICTREE BUSTA (3), WICKED DE LIL (4) SUGGESTED BET: CHECHINGOUTTHEBILL (8) to win.

ROLLONX (3) has always had good gate speed and may be able to zip across and lead in this race before having options from there. He comes into this race third up from a spell and should be building towards peak fitness. ROCKNROLL DA GAMA (7) ran well in his head of the showcase series at Marburg when finishing fourth before not being as suited on a hot tempo last time out. He drops back to his own grade and draws to get a soft run. TAKE COURAGE (5) is a capable sit sprinter and could be suited getting back in a race there could be a genuine tempo. She ran well last time out in a slightly stronger race taken out by Sammys Secret. BEAU STEELE (9) has dropped a long way back in grade off some of his better efforts into this company. He ran a good second two starts ago behind The Harris Hawk at this track and a similar effort would see him hard to beat in this race. SELECTIONS: ROLLONX (3), ROCKNROLL DA GAMA (7), TAKE COURAGE (5), BEAU STEELE (9) SUGGESTED BET: ROCKNROLL DA GAMA (7) each way.

WANNABE ME (2) has been taking on much stronger company including last start when sitting leaders back behind Mackenzie Reg and finishing sixth. She should find this a lot easier and may be able to press to the lead in the early stages. TUSCANS COURAGE (1) has been racing well and appears close to a maiden win having put together four consecutive placings. He sat without cover last time out and wasn’t beaten far there behind Hungry For More at Marburg. OLIVIA RHAYNE BOW (9) got back in the run and was running on well into third behind Azzif. She appears likely to get a similar run in this race and can be running on late again. STRAWBERRIESNCREAM (7) draws a touch awkwardly inside the back row in this race. She secured a good run two starts ago and was able to battle on well for third behind Gift Giver and Mullum Suzzle. SELECTIONS: WANNABE ME (2), TUSCANS COURAGE (1), OLIVIA RHAYNE BOW (9), STRAWBERRIESNCREAM (7) SUGGESTED BET: WANNABE ME (2) to win.

TINTIN IN LOGAN (1) has been building with each run since returning from a spell and looks ready to take out her maiden. She was well beaten last time out but took on much stronger company there in a race which was taken out by Mullum Sizzle over Jewel Reason. BOSTON BOUND (8) ran a good race for third behind Feeling Happy last time out. She is having her fourth career start in this race and draws to do no work early again. She should be hard to hold out. AURELIE (6) ran well enough for this type of race in a recent trial at Albion Park which was taken out by Mythical Dragon. She draws poorly in this race due to being ODM but has good place claims. MELTON FOURHUNDRED (3) nabbed the position leaders back last time out and was able to battle on for third behind Hungry For More. She should get a good run off the speed and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: TINTIN IN LOGAN (1), BOSTON BOUND (8), AURELIE (6), MELTON FOURHUNDRED (3) SUGGESTED BET: TINTIN IN LOGAN (1) to win.
